thread:
leah-partnerships: Heads-up — we need a coordinated plan for the SDK deprecation we're announcing next quarter. This touches cloud marketplace listings, hw partners (edge boxes), and SI integrators. Proposing a phased approach with shims + notice cadence. Thoughts? :wave:

jon-eng: +1 on phased. Can we spell out the phases? e.g., shim -> dual-run -> opt-out -> remove. Need timelines for marketplace certification cycles.

priya-ecosys: Marketplace folks require 60–90 day review windows. For AWS Marketplace we should allow 90 days for new SKU validation. For GCP it's closer to 60. Also hardware partners need firmware bump windows — some vendors only do quarterly updates.

leah-partnerships: Good call. Proposed high-level schedule: 1) announce deprecation + compat shim (T0), 2) 30d telemetry + canary, 3) 60d partner review + docs, 4) 120d opt-out flag, 5) 180d remove. Does that map to your constraints?

marek-sre: Telemetry note: we need a temporary telemetry header to identify shim usage so we can track failures without PII. Suggest header: `X-RW-Shim: v1` and emit aggregated counts to /internal/partner-compat. Will require a small runtime change and metric dashboard.

jon-eng: Implementation checklist I can take: - add header support and opt-out flag - ship shim artifact (npm/pypi) - add e2e with hardware emulators - update marketplace manifests. ETA: 3 weeks for initial shim + tests.

priya-ecosys: Partner comms: I'll draft partner-facing copy. Need approval on the phrasing. Draft ask: 90-day minimum for marketplace vendors, opt-out mechanism docs, clear rollback steps. Tagging legal for required notice language.

leah-partnerships: Thanks. Can we also include a short sample developer notice for the marketplace tile and partner portal? e.g., “Note: vX SDK will be deprecated on YYYY-MM-DD. Please upgrade or enable compat shim by then to avoid interruption.”

jon-eng: Putting a tiny example CLI and env snippet for partners to opt-in the shim quickly:
```
# install shim
pip install redwood-sdk-shim==1.0.0
# enable via env
export REDWOOD_SDK_COMPAT=shim-v1
```

marek-sre: For rollout safety, let's gate by percentage over 2 weeks: 0->10->50->100 and auto-revert on error spike > 2x baseline. I'll add runbook entries. Also add an alert: `partner_compat_error_rate`.

priya-ecosys: Will collect partner update windows and call out any that need >90 days. Also prepping a matrix: cloud marketplace, hw partner, SI integrator, certification delta, expected lead time. I'll share the sheet after this thread.

leah-partnerships: Actions: (1) Jon -> shim + header + tests (ETA 3w), (2) Marek -> metrics + rollout policy + runbook (ETA 2w), (3) Priya -> partner comms + partner window matrix + legal coord (ETA 1w draft). I'll schedule a 30-min sync next Tue to review drafts. :calendar:

deployer-bot: deploy queued: feature/compat-shim-metrics -> staging (job 4823). Logs at https://ci.redwood.ai/job/4823 :robot_face:

jon-eng: Noted, will watch staging. Thanks everyone.

leah-partnerships: Great — will follow up with calendar invite and PR templates for marketplace copy. :thumbsup:
